1.consolidated_definition: . Volver a considerar. (Otro verbo formado con el prefijo re- que denota repetición, como recalentar, recocer, reedificar, etc. La Ac. no ha aceptado a reconsiderar. “¿Acaso, en España, nada se reconsidera?” preguntaba Ricardo Palma).
1.en_consolidated_definition: To reconsider. (Another verb formed with the prefix re- denoting repetition, such as to reheat, to recook, to rebuild, etc. The Academia has not accepted "to reconsider". "Is anything in Spain ever reconsidered?" Ricardo Palma asked.)
